data.one_liner: Check the availability of Google Play services on an Android device.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that allows developers to check the availability of Google Play services on the current device. It provides methods to check availability and handle user resolutions on Android.
use_when: You need to verify if Google Play services are available before using dependent features.
You want to provide a friendly prompt or fix option to users when Google Play services are missing or outdated.
avoid_when: You are developing for iOS, as support for iOS has been removed.
You do not use Google Play services in your app.
strengths: Simple API to query Google Play services availability.
Supports showing system dialogs to resolve availability issues.
weaknesses: Requires proper native configuration for Android.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. Ensure proper Android build settings as per standard Android plugins.
